messages:
maria: FYI pushing image redwood/runtime:2026-03-15-canary to ECR us-west-2 failed promotion — deploy-bot flagged attestation timestamp mismatch. Holding canary.
jamal: link to logs? did the cosign step run on the builder? @deploy-bot what error?
maria: logs:
```
deploy-bot: provenance check failed: attestation.timestamp 2026-03-15T11:22:07Z != manifest.timestamp 2026-03-15T11:22:10Z
Action: block_publish
```
maria: pushed layers are present, digest matches, but attestation TTL is tiny and CI clock skewed slightly.
deploy-bot: Automated message: publish blocked for redwood/runtime:2026-03-15-canary — reason: provenance_timestamp_mismatch. See run 7895.
sophia: can we retag with the same digest and attach a newly-signed attestation? cosign supports re-signing artifacts in a controlled job.
jamal: re-sign is safest. plan:
1) fetch manifest digest
2) run the re-sign job in a hermetic runner with correct clock
3) attach attestation and re-run deploybot publish
maria: I'm going to create a short window to re-sign and repush. If not done in 20m we'll roll back canary to v2026-03-14-stable. @alex please standby.
ops-bot: Scheduled rollback alarm set for +20m unless `approve-publish` tag is added.
jamal: adding a short release note: 'canary held due to attestation timestamp mismatch; re-signing in progress' — will update after repush.
sophia: command snippets I used to inspect digests locally:
```
AWS_ECR_URI=123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/runtime
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/runtime --image-ids imageTag=2026-03-15-canary --query 'images[0].imageId.imageDigest' --output text
# then verify attestation (example)
cosign verify-attestation --key $COSIGN_KEY $AWS_ECR_URI@sha256:abcd1234...
```
maria: started ephemeral job to re-sign at run/7900. Will ping when done :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
jamal: ack. if re-sign fails we do immediate rollback; keep release notes and pin in rollout config.
sophia: adding pin: in rollout config set `image: redwood/runtime@sha256:<stable-digest>` to lock prod.
maria: updated rollout: canary paused, pinned previous digest for production, documented in #eng-releases. Closing loop once republish succeeds.
deploy-bot: Automated message: run/7900 completed — new attestation attached, publish allowed. Action: promote-canary.
maria: promoted. marking incident resolved. :white_check_mark:
